review_scope: Independent visual comparison of final generated render pixels with privately reviewed official C-block floor plan, roof plan, four elevations, A/C sections, and C-labelled 2011 construction photographs. This is not a structural, dimensional-survey or physical-print certification.

confirmed_matches.result: Independent low-long body, planted flat roof and inclined planted end masses; no A/B U-shaped courtyard substituted.
Front spectator tiers are split by the central covered C201 platform; rear classroom doors and window bands remain distinct under the projecting eave.
Outward-rising central canopy is attached to its platform; the displaced CAD roof projection was not modeled as a detached building.
Warm ochre wall/edge, vegetation green, dark glazing proxy and light metal railing family are supported by C-labelled photos and drawings. Values remain approximate, not photo-calibrated.
Four roof monitors now read as narrow elongated elements instead of the prior square oversized caps.

resolved_findings.original_finding: Each of the four roof ventilation monitors was roughly 2.6 m wide, conflicting with the roof plan dimension chain 100 / 260 / 100 cm.
resolved_findings.resolution: Author reduced nominal curb width to 1.00 m and cap width to 1.30 m. Actual new central_detail and oblique/front renders were re-inspected and show the correct narrow proportion.
resolved_findings.residual_approximation: Centers remain 3.70 m apart versus drawing-derived 3.60 m; 0.10 m design-space difference is 0.16 mm at this miniature scale. Monitor y length, hood thickness and precise service detailing remain simplified.

resolved_findings.original_finding: High rear camera hid most glazing beneath the eave.
resolved_findings.resolution: Lower rear view and rear_detail render now clearly expose repetitive classroom window/door rhythm and the end ramp transition.

accepted_approximations: Solid classroom exterior proxy, without reconstructed interior
Opaque colored window faces for miniature printing
Thickened rails with reduced horizontal bar count
Simplified seating tiers, treads and access stair relief
Source-derived service core, canopy and roof monitor details not claimed as fully verified as-built construction
Authored display base not represented as campus terrain
limitations: 2011 photos document construction stage, not a 2026 survey.
Central canopy form is official-CAD-supported; this photo set does not show a finished close view of it.
Rear detail subdivisions rely on drawings with miniature simplification.
Visual correspondence is distinct from manifold, thickness, support and exchange-format validation.
source_privacy: This report contains only findings and hashes of original model renders. No third-party photographs, CAD source drawings, source crops or PDF pages are included.
